# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "pcdwba",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "pcdwba-theory.html",
    Implementation = "pcdwba-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "pcdwba-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "pcdwba-validation.html"
  )
)
```

PCDWBA validation uses the weak curved-cylinder regime and compares the curved-body approximation against BCMS and radial FEM finite-cylinder results. The validation set covers frequency, incidence angle, boundary/material condition, body size, and curvature.

::: {.tip data-title="Reading residuals"}
Mean absolute residuals describe typical agreement across a sweep. Maximum residuals are retained because narrow TS nulls can dominate a single point.
:::

## TS-Frequency

The frequency sweep uses straight and bent finite cylinders from `12-400 kHz`.

| Validation method | Boundary / material | Geometry | Frequency (kHz) | Angle (deg) | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| radial FEM / BCMS | fixed rigid | bent cylinder | 12-400 | 90 | 0.008 | 0.019 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | gas filled | bent cylinder | 12-400 | 90 | 0.002 | 0.045 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | liquid filled | bent cylinder | 12-400 | 90 | 0.026 | 0.073 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | pressure release | bent cylinder | 12-400 | 90 | 0.001 | 0.003 |

## TS-Orientation

The orientation sweep uses near-broadside incidence over `12-200 kHz`.

|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| radial FEM / BCMS | fixed rigid | bent cylinder | truncated normal broadside | 12-200 | 0.178 | 0.274 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | fixed rigid | bent cylinder | uniform near broadside | 12-200 | 0.661 | 1.132 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | gas filled | bent cylinder | truncated normal broadside | 12-200 | 0.024 | 0.031 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | gas filled | bent cylinder | uniform near broadside | 12-200 | 0.096 | 0.137 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | liquid filled | bent cylinder | truncated normal broadside | 12-200 | 0.215 | 0.325 |

| radial FEM / BCMS | pressure release | bent cylinder | uniform near broadside | 12-200 | 0.096 | 0.148 |

## TS-Size And Curvature

Size and curvature checks use the same cylinder family while changing the body scale or curvature scale.

| Validation method | Boundary / material | Geometry | Sweep | Frequency (kHz) | Angle (deg) | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| radial FEM / BCMS | fixed rigid | bent cylinder | length scale | 120 | 90 | 0.495 | 1.034 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | gas filled | bent cylinder | length scale | 120 | 90 | 0.065 | 0.126 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | liquid filled | bent cylinder | length scale | 120 | 90 | 0.563 | 1.108 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | pressure release | bent cylinder | length scale | 120 | 90 | 0.089 | 0.142 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | fixed rigid | bent cylinder | curvature scale | 120 | 90 | 0.366 | 0.865 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | gas filled | bent cylinder | curvature scale | 120 | 90 | 0.055 | 0.130 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | liquid filled | bent cylinder | curvature scale | 120 | 90 | 0.438 | 0.986 |
| radial FEM / BCMS | pressure release | bent cylinder | curvature scale | 120 | 90 | 0.054 | 0.128 |
